title: Grade 3 Science — Fri, Jun 05
description: Animal Life — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis — features, movement, food, homes and young
subject: science

questions.question: Which feature helps a bird to fly?
questions.explanation: Birds have wings and light feathers that help them fly in the air.

questions.question: How many legs does an insect like an ant have?
questions.explanation: All insects, including ants, have six legs.

questions.question: A fish moves through water using its:
questions.explanation: Fish use fins and a tail to swim and move in water.

questions.question: Which animal hops to move from place to place?
questions.explanation: Frogs have strong back legs and move by hopping.

questions.question: A cow eats only plants. Such animals are called:
questions.explanation: Animals that eat only plants are called plant-eaters (herbivores).

questions.question: A lion eats other animals. Such animals are called:
questions.explanation: Animals that eat the flesh of other animals are called meat-eaters (carnivores).

questions.question: The home of a honeybee is a hive. The home of a horse is a:
questions.explanation: Horses are kept in a stable.

questions.question: Which young one matches its parent correctly?
questions.explanation: A baby cat is called a kitten.

questions.question: A snake has no legs. How does it move?
questions.explanation: Snakes move by crawling and sliding their body along the ground.

questions.question: Which of these animals lays eggs?
questions.explanation: A hen lays eggs, while a cow, dog and goat give birth to live young.

questions.question: A butterfly has wings but is not a bird. It is an:
questions.explanation: A butterfly is an insect with six legs and a pair of wings.

questions.question: Animals build homes mainly to:
options: Stay safe and protect their young
questions.explanation: Animals build shelters to keep safe from danger and weather and to protect their babies.

questions.question: Which animal has a body covered with scales?
questions.explanation: A fish has a body covered with scales, which protect it in the water.

questions.question: A spider catches its food using its:
questions.explanation: A spider spins a web to trap insects for food.

questions.question: Which list correctly groups only birds?
questions.explanation: Crow, sparrow and parrot are all birds — they have wings, feathers and a beak.
